subject: english
stem: Why can 'some' take is in 'There is some bread'?
options: Bread refers to a past event.
Bread is uncountable in this use.

optionRationales.reason: Bread refers to a past event.：句中沒有過去線索。
Bread is uncountable in this use.：some 後的核心名詞 bread 作不可數概念。
Some always means one.：some 不等於 one。
Is is a plural form.：is 是單數形式。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「依存在物核心名詞的數與事件時間，選擇 there is/are 或 there was/were，並在多項清單中保持資訊精確。」可推出 Bread is uncountable in this use.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Bread is uncountable in this use. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
